researchRecord.fastify_5_12_2: SECURITY release (2026-09-04): fixes for GHSA-9q9j-q6p8-xq58 / CVE-2026-84428 (high — header validation bypass via incomplete schema case normalization), GHSA-hwr6-493r-vm6h / CVE-2026-84469 (high — request validation bypass via skipped boolean false schemas), GHSA-p68q-wchp-6fh7 / CVE-2026-76169 (high — authentication bypass via malformed URLs reaching encapsulated not-found handlers), GHSA-667r-xxjv-c9mm / CVE-2026-84504 (high — request body replacement via an async validation result collision); plus the backported fix: callNotFound runs the not-found preHandler regardless of registration order (PR 6973) and an npm-ignore chore (PR 7003)
researchRecord.fastify_5_12_3: version-bump only — no functional changelog entry (published as part of the version-mismatch repair)
researchRecord.fastify_5_12_4: release note: 'Fixed the fastify.js version mismatch' — the tag compare v5.12.2...v5.12.4 contains only the two 'Bumped v5.12.3'/'Bumped v5.12.4' commits
researchRecord.fastify_5_12_5: SECURITY release (2026-09-16): fix for GHSA-4mh8-r7rc-xpvc / CVE-2026-92081 (medium — DoS via unhandled exception on HTTP/2 trailer responses); plus backported perf: reduce content-type parser overhead (PR 7019) and avoid redundant request-part reads during validation (PR 7020)
researchRecord.fastify_usageSurface: src/api/server.ts + src/api/routes/* use addHook(onRoute/onRequest/onResponse), standard route registration and error mapping; the test planes use fastify.inject. The 5.12.x fixes strengthen exactly the repo's exercised surfaces — schema/body validation (the honest 401/422 boundaries), the not-found handler path (the honest 404s), and header handling — with zero API-shape changes; all are patch-level backports inside ^5.12.1
researchRecord.pg_ladder: 8.17.0: throw the correct error when database URL parsing fails; 8.17.1/8.17.2: break-fix patches (undocumented in the changelog per its stated 'no break-fix versions in this file' policy; no release-note bodies on the repo tags); 8.18.0: connect() returns the client instance (previously void — additive); 8.19.0: the internal query queue is deprecated + connection parameters are passed to the password callback; 8.20.0: onConnect callback in pg.Pool constructor options (async initialization of newly created & connected pooled clients); 8.21.0: SASL SCRAM server error responses handled properly + node@26 support + the scramMaxIterations config option + client.getTransactionStatus(); 8.22.0: sslnegotiation=direct for PostgreSQL 17+; 8.23.0: query pipelining support (PR 3652)
researchRecord.pg_usageSurface: src/platform/db/pg-database-port.ts uses new Pool(...), pool.connect(), client.query(sql, params) and BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK transaction blocks; the integration harness (the Lead's rail) uses Client + Pool. Every pg change in the span is additive (new options, new methods, error-handling fixes) — none alters the repo's call shapes; the SASL SCRAM error-handling fix improves the auth path on the PG rail
